column2:
Create a decision log template I can use to document important business decisions. For each decision entry, include fields for:
(1) Date and decision title, (2) Context — what prompted this decision (2-3 sentences), (3) Options considered — what were the alternatives, (4) Decision made — what I chose, (5) Reasoning — why I chose this (key factors), (6) Expected outcome — what I expect to happen, (7) Risks accepted — what could go wrong that I'm OK with, (8) Review date — when I'll check if this was the right call, (9) Outcome (filled in later) — what actually happened.
Also give me: 5 example entries for common solopreneur decisions [in my industry: [describe]] to show how it works in practice. This is for building a personal decision-making track record so I can learn from my own patterns.

I want to start thinking about [selling my business / stepping back from day-to-day / bringing on a partner to run operations / transitioning from freelancer to agency].

My business: [describe — revenue, team, years in business, what makes it valuable].

Help me think through:
(1) What my business is worth today (suggest valuation methods for a [my type of business] and what factors drive the number up or down),
(2) What I'd need to change to make it sellable/transferable (what depends on me personally vs. what runs without me),
(3) A 12-month plan to increase my business's value and reduce key-person dependency,
(4) Options for exit — sell, hire a GM, bring on a partner, license the model, etc.,
(5) Pros/cons of each option,
(6) The 3 things to start working on NOW regardless of which path I choose.

Design a customer research survey for [purpose — e.g., "understanding why customers churn," "validating a new product idea," "measuring satisfaction"]. My audience: [describe]. I'll distribute it via [email / in-app / social media / other].
Give me: (1) Survey title and intro paragraph that explains why they should take it and how long it takes, (2) 12-15 questions in logical order — mix of multiple choice, rating scale (1-5), and open-ended, (3) For each question: the question text and WHY I'm asking it (what decision it informs), (4) A thank-you message with an incentive mention if applicable: [describe incentive — discount, entry in giveaway, early access, etc.], (5) How to analyze the results — what patterns to look for in each question.
